viewing_check: Check the species by smell (strong sweet Huon pine oil) and colour; confirm there are two slabs in the lot not three, measure width and thickness, and look for birdseye, rot in the bark edges and splits. Wider (40 cm+) clear slabs are what reached $100 to $180.
